revision_reason: R2 modelled Panda execution mismatch as a constant action gain. Policy-free free-space pulses instead resolved a causal two-sample delay plus an 80-ms first-order response. Previously exposed contact motions then identified the MuJoCo implementation scale required for the same declared tool-drive stiffness.
research_question: Does the revised transparent MuJoCo task port reproduce new policy-independent PhysX motions closely enough to permit frozen-checkpoint zero-shot evaluation?
scope: Cross-engine simulation robustness; not hardware validation, Sim2Real evidence, or full Panda robot equivalence.
decision_rule: Both new held-out motions must satisfy every frozen tolerance. A pass permits a separate zero-shot checkpoint study; a failure blocks policy deployment and is reported without tuning on these motions.
